subject: Error when combining files for analysis

messages.author: c94b942c670d34bd
messages.subject: Error when combining files for analysis
parts:
Hi, 

I am analysing multiple .CWA files concurrently (n=118) and have first processed them in smaller batches (n=5) before combining all of the flies in a single analysis run using the script below.

Specifically when do.report=(2) is run, I get the following error message:
Report part 2 1 2 3 4Error in names(x) <- value : 'names' attribute [36] must be the same length as the vector [35] In addition: Warning message: In colnames(QCout)[newcols] <- newcolnames : number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

This error is specifically limited to when trying to generate the report for part 2 and there is no issue with the analysis when part 2 is omitted.

Is anyone able to advise where the issue might be?

Thanks!
Keven

library(GGIR)
GGIR(mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
     datadir="C:/Users",
     outputdir="D:/AX3_GGIR",
     overwrite=FALSE,
     #=====================
     # Part 2
     #=====================
     strategy = 1,
     hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
     maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
     qwindow=c(0,24),
     mvpathreshold =c(100),
     excludefirstlast = FALSE,
     includenightcrit = 16,
     #=====================
     # Part 3 + 4
     #=====================
     def.noc.sleep = 1,
     outliers.only = TRUE,
     criterror = 4,
     do.visual = TRUE,
     #=====================
     # Part 5
     #=====================
     threshold.lig = c(81.25), threshold.mod = c(262.5),  threshold.vig = c(725),
     boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
     boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
     boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
     includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
     #=====================
     # Visual report
     #=====================
     do.report=c(2,4,5),
     timewindow = c("WW","MM"),
     visualreport=TRUE,
     dofirstpage = TRUE, #first page of pdf-report with simple summary histograms
     viewingwindow=1) #viewingwindow of visual report: 1 centres at day and 2 centers at night

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error when combining files for analysis
parts:
Hi Keven,

I think this is a bug I fixed in the past week. Could you try installing the latest development version of GGIR and trying again?

library(remotes)
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR")

I am now working with a group who is processing thousands of CWA files with the latest GGIR version and for them everything seems to be working fine.

Thanks, Vincent
